denoising with a large step is a key to fast sampling in diffusion models, and that denoising GANs can be used to model the complex denoising distributions.
we introduce denoising GANs that are fast and generate good samples, and we show that they can be used for many applications.
denoising with a complex distribution enables large steps in diffusion models, leading to fast sampling.

diffusion models are fundamentally slow and that the proposed approach can be applied to other diffusion-based generative models to reduce the sampling time.
